TATAPOWER: Borrowings rose Rs 17,500 cr in FY26 to fund a capex plan that has already slipped; leverage is rising while returns stay thin.
JIOFIN: A Rs 1.4-lakh-crore valuation still resting mostly on treasury income; the operating businesses are too young to carry the price.
DEEPAKNTR: A commodity downcycle name: FY22's peak margins have halved and the price still assumes the cycle returns quickly.
HINDCOPPER: FY26's profit boom is copper price, not mining volume; the capacity ramp is delayed and a PSU stake-sale overhang sits at a peak multiple.
